subject: Volume roadmap & SLA scenario review
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@adepthealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: AdeptHealth Legal <legal@adepthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + follow-up from demo — traffic snapshots and budget ranges

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the demo earlier — the team found the hosted API latency profile and burst handling very promising. Per our call, I wanted to share the rough traffic numbers so you can confirm whether our pricing/commit thinking is in the right ballpark. Attached is a quick spreadsheet with current estimates. Key points: 

- Expected steady-state: 18M–28M tokens / month for Q1 after launch (text gen only).
- Upside scenario (feature expansion): up to ~60M tokens / month by month 6.
- Peak concurrency on certain flows: we expect short-lived bursts up to ~40–50 TPS (90s windows), baseline peaks ~12–18 TPS.
- Target unit economics: we are aiming for $80–$120 per 1M tokens billed (depending on commitment and model tier).

Can you confirm: 1) what the hosted API per-1M tiers look like for those volumes, 2) how Redwood would handle 50 TPS burst windows (autoscale + billing), and 3) an example monthly cost breakdown for the 18M and 60M scenarios?

Next steps from our side: we want a short written quote and a recommended scenario so we can present to finance next week.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Product
AdeptHealth

Attachment: traffic_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet — monthly token rows, peak TPS column)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@adepthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + follow-up from demo — traffic snapshots and budget ranges

Hi Samira — great talking yesterday. Quick recap and what we'll deliver by EOD Friday: 

On your asks (short answers):
- Per-1M pricing: baseline (on-demand): $95 / 1M; 6–12 month committed tiers start at $75 / 1M (depends on commit size and SLA).
- Burst handling: hosted API supports short bursts up to 90s at sustained autoscale; bursts are metered by tokens generated during the burst window and subject to transient capacity surcharge (we'll show examples below).
- Example cost breakdowns: we will provide line-item cost tables for 18M and 60M monthly profiles plus a Peak TPS sensitivity sheet.

I'll attach a short pricing summary (PDF) and Ben will follow with specific scenario math. Proposed next steps: 
1) Ben/Marissa to draft 3 pricing scenarios (conservative / growth / high-burst) with per-month cost and $/1M effective price.
2) We’ll produce a DocuSign-ready quote and SOW draft for your review.
3) If SOC 2 evidence is required, Marissa will surface the checklist.

On quoting cadence: if you can confirm which scenario (conservative / growth / aggressive) you expect to proceed with by Monday Nov 15, we can get legal/finance on a signed quote within 3–4 business days.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-hosted-pricing-summary.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@adepthealth.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Volume roadmap & SLA scenario review — scenarios attached

Hi Samira / Priya — following up with three concrete scenarios (see attached CSV). Short summary here: 

Scenario A — Conservative launch- 18M tokens / month- Effective $/1M (on-demand): ~$95- Monthly cost: ~$1,710

Scenario B — Growth plan (recommended for Q2 commit)- 30M tokens / month- Committed 12-mo tier price: $72 / 1M effective- Monthly cost: ~$2,160- Additional note: 25 TPS baseline with 60 TPS burst windows handled; estimated transient surcharge for bursts: ~$400–$600 in high-peak months

Scenario C — Aggressive / feature expansion- 60M tokens / month- Volume discount blended price: ~$60–65 / 1M- Monthly cost: ~$3,600–$3,900

Assumptions and clarifications:
- Burst metering: we meter tokens generated during the burst window. We recommend a committed baseline for predictable unit economics and to reduce transient surge surcharges.
- SLA/uptime: hosted SLA for committed customers includes 99.9% uptime and prioritized routing; we'll include explicit latency SLOs per route in the quote.
- SOC 2 & evidence: Marissa will attach the compliance artifact checklist in the formal quote.

Next actions: 
- Priya / Marissa to push the formal quote + SOW once you confirm which scenario you want priced and whether you need SOC 2 evidence attached.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: scenario-costs.csv

Thanks Ben / Priya — this is helpful. We reviewed the three scenarios internally and are leaning toward Scenario B (30M / mo, 12-mo commit). A few clarifications before we ask finance to sign: 

- Please produce a written quote showing the $72 / 1M committed price, monthly invoice estimate, and a short note on how burst surcharges are calculated (example month with 60 TPS spikes).
- We need a draft SOW and the standard Redwood hosted terms for legal to review. Our legal team (legal@adepthealth.com) will be copied on the next doc.
- SOC 2: not mandatory for launch, but we will request the evidence pack prior to renewals.
- Timing: if we receive the quote + SOW by EOD Wednesday Nov 17, we can loop finance and aim to sign the week of Nov 22.

Let me know if you need anything else from our side (traffic buckets, auth flow details).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Samira
Head of Product, AdeptHealth
